summary.title: Call of Duty Mobile New Season Weapon Tier List and Buff/Nerf Analysis
summary.executive_summary: This discussion provided an in-depth review of the top 10 weapons for the new season in Call of Duty Mobile, focusing on recent buffs and nerfs that impact gameplay. The speakers highlighted several key weapons, including the Chopper, Kilo 141 (referred to as NIC), DRH, Switchblade, Type 19, X and 4, Oden, and SO410, offering insights into their performance, versatility, and optimal usage. The conversation emphasized significant changes like the Tundra's nerf and the continuous buffs to the Switchblade, influencing the current weapon meta and providing player recommendations.
key_decisions: The Chopper remains a top-tier LMG due to its sustained performance and versatility.
The Kilo 141 (NIC), especially with the 'Donkless' perk, has received significant buffs and is considered a potentially best-in-game weapon.
The Tundra sniper received a nerf but is still considered viable, while the 3 Line Rifle and DL2 are emerging as strong alternatives.
The DRH is confirmed as one of the best assault rifles.
The Switchblade SMG has received continuous and substantial buffs, positioning it as a potentially number one weapon in the game.
Both the Type 19 and X and 4 are recommended as excellent weapons, occupying the number 5 spot.
The RAM 7 received a notable buff, and the BMP is arguably the best close-range SMG.
The CX9 has been significantly nerfed and is no longer a top-tier close-range SMG.
The Oden assault rifle is highly regarded as an unbelievable weapon, effective in both multiplayer and Battle Royale.
The UAS sub-machine gun is considered more versatile than the Oden and a top-tier SMG.
Despite recent nerfs, the SO410 is still deemed the best gun in Call of Duty Mobile and is highly recommended for current use.

topics.name: Chopper LMG Analysis
topics.summary: The Chopper LMG maintains its position as a top weapon from the previous season, highlighted for its effectiveness with the 'big heavy handle' attachment, allowing players to shoot through walls and hold strategic angles.

topics.name: Call of Duty Mobile Sponsorship & HPK Honorable Mention
topics.summary: The video was sponsored by Call of Duty Mobile, encouraging viewers to download the game. The HPK was given an honorable mention as an amazing weapon, though not quite making it into the top 10 list.

topics.name: Kilo 141 (NIC) Buffs and Performance
topics.summary: The Kilo 141, referred to as NIC, has received significant buffs this season. When paired with the 'Donkless' perk, it's suggested to be potentially the best gun in the game, despite its past reputation, and is highly recommended for players to try.

topics.name: Tundra Sniper Nerf and Alternatives
topics.summary: The Tundra sniper received another nerf due to its prolonged dominance. While still good, the 3 Line Rifle and DL2 are noted as strong contenders that could quickly surpass it in performance.

topics.name: DRH Assault Rifle Review
topics.summary: The DRH is praised as one of the best assault rifles in the game, noted as a personal favorite, partly due to its unique 'furred snickers' skin.

topics.name: Lackman Weapon Performance
topics.summary: The Lackman, a weapon released 4-5 months ago, is described as a great, super versatile, and enjoyable weapon to use, making a strong impact upon its release.

topics.name: Switchblade SMG Continuous Buffs
topics.summary: The Switchblade SMG has received consistent buffs over the last 5-6 updates, including more this season. Speakers question the reasoning behind the continuous buffs, predicting it will easily become the number one gun in the game, especially anticipating a mythic variant.

topics.name: P90 (People Ubi) Buff
topics.summary: The P90, referred to as People Ubi, also received a buff in the current update. The speaker expressed regret that this buff didn't happen earlier, recounting a frustrating experience using it in a 'rookie to legendary' challenge before its improvements.

topics.name: Type 19 and X and 4 Weapons
topics.summary: Both the Type 19 and X and 4 are ranked at the number 5 spot, described as wonderful and pleasurable to use. The Type 19 is a personal favorite for one speaker, while the X and 4 is also noted as popular among players.

topics.name: RAM 7 Buff and BMP (PPSh-41?) Performance
topics.summary: The RAM 7 received a notable buff, making it a weapon to consider. The BMP is arguably highlighted as the best close-range SMG in the game.

topics.name: CX9 Nerfs and Secondary Weapons
topics.summary: The CX9, previously a top close-range SMG, has been repeatedly nerfed, particularly regarding its magnetite attachment, relegating it to an honorable mention. The Machine Pistol and L-car, though buffed, are secondary weapons and thus not included in the top 10 primary guns list.

topics.name: Oden Assault Rifle Ranking
topics.summary: The Oden assault rifle is ranked at number 3. It's described as an unbelievable 'March and Rifle' that is also highly effective in Battle Royale, consistently performing well over several months.

topics.name: UAS (SMG) and SO410 (Best Gun) Analysis
topics.summary: The UAS is considered more versatile than the Oden and is a top-tier sub-machine gun. Despite recent nerfs, the SO410 is still confidently declared as the best gun in Call of Duty Mobile, with a strong recommendation for all players to start using it immediately.
